title: Help shape SusPixels
body:
Got a feature idea, or something you'd love to see on the canvas? We're listening.

[Share your suggestions here](https://forms.gle/hUZbwn48edpLYWsX6)

title: Chat is live — with GIF support
body:
The old third-party shoutbox is gone. We now have a fully native chat built into the app.

**What's new:**

- Real-time messages powered by the same WebSocket as the canvas
- Send GIFs from Giphy using the GIF button
- @mention other users — their name highlights in purple
- Sound notification + unread badge when new messages arrive
- Your app avatar and prestige badge show in chat
- Guests can read chat but need to log in to send messages
